title: Kissed by Fire Irish Beef Stew
description: A sweet and molten Irish beef stew made with minced beef, perfect for a romantic date-night dinner.

ingredients.name: Minced Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio for best flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: Red Wine
ingredients.notes: dry red wine for depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Tomato Paste
ingredients.notes: concentrated tomato paste for rich flavor.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.notes: adds sweetness and depth to the stew.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.notes: dried thyme for aroma and flavor.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: freshly ground black pepper for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: unrefined sea salt for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: unsalted butter for richness and flavor.

ingredients.name: Heavy Cream
ingredients.notes: adds creaminess and richness to the stew.

instructions: Heat the butter in the yakimono-grill over medium heat.
Sear the minced beef until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Remove the browned beef from the grill and set it aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the grill and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the grill and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, beef stock, tomato paste, brown sugar, thyme, black pepper, and salt to the grill.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the browned beef to the grill and stir to combine.
Transfer the stew to a terracotta dish and cover with a lid.
Bake the stew in a preheated oven at 180 17C (350 AF) for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, remove the stew from the oven and stir in the heavy cream.
Return the stew to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cream has thickened and the stew is hot and bubbly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
